1879064383.name: Bright Camp-fire
1879064383.desc: Build a camp-fire to quicken allies' recovery.\n\nEnables some crafting skills.

1879095103.name: Fell Spirit's Terror (Ranged)
1879095103.desc: This warband skill does direct ranged damage to your target, then transfers morale to you from your target and can contribute to warband manoeuvres.

1879117759.name: Fierce Resolve
1879117759.desc: Drains morale from nearby enemies over time to heal the Warden.

1879136959.name: Wrath
1879136959.desc: You are able to push past the limits of your wounded body in order to continue fighting.

1879139391.name: Sweeping Cut
1879139391.desc: Large sweeping strokes cut into all of your foes standing before you.

1879159999.name: Yule Festival Pony
1879159999.desc: A pony from the Yule Festival.

1879212095.name: Black Silk Glove
1879212095.desc: This black silk glove has a name stitched into its wrist: 'Bigby'.

1879213887.name: Surgical Strike (Melee)
1879213887.desc: Your Fellowship strikes at Draigoch's front left leg, reducing its ability to resist damage.

1879215039.name: Crude Map to Grimwood
1879215039.desc: A crudely drawn and horribly detailed map to Grimwood.

1879222591.name: Guide to Galtrev
1879222591.desc: Returns you and your Fellowship to Galtrev in Dunland.\n\nThis skill is easily interrupted.

1879227839.name: Ring of Acid
1879227839.desc: Harness the power of Acid to provide a powerful boon to an ally without a ring.

1879244863.name: Assault of the Eorlingas
1879244863.desc: A violent strike against the target that focuses on your offensive capability, dealing damage and applying a bleed to the target.\n\n<rgb=#66ffff>Applies the Lance effect to you. Skill of the Eorlingas becomes Lancer's Charge.</rgb>

1879245631.name: Debate Wrath
1879245631.desc: A strength that all Rune-keepers possess is the ability to speak well on any subject. This proves to be a great benefit in the midst of a heated debate, and this benefit can prove very potent and effective.

1879247807.name: Horn Blast
1879247807.desc: The Champion uses his battle-horn to drive fear into the hearts of his enemies and their steeds.

1879260479.name: The Last Stand of Helm Hammerhand
1879260479.desc: You sing the song of the ninth King of Rohan and the tale of his last stand inspires those who hear it to fight to the bitter end.

1879276095.name: Fortification
1879276095.desc: You steel your resolve and focus on your defences.

1879302591.name: Call to Arms: Herald of War (Defender)
1879302591.desc: You enlist a Herald to carry your Banner of War into battle. This banner increases the damage dealt by those around it.

1879324223.name: Steed of New Bloom
1879324223.desc: A pony from the Spring Festival.

1879338175.name: Muster in after-battle Minas Tirith
1879338175.desc: Allows the Warden to travel to after-battle Minas Tirith.

1879341375.name: Steed of the North Ithilien Wilds

1879411775.name: Fulgurant Strike
1879411775.desc: This strike catches the enemy unawares, leaving them breathless and interrupting complex skills and manoeuvres.\n\nInterrupts

1879414207.name: Winter Hobby-deer
1879414207.desc: A creative winter toy.\n\nYou may ride it in most towns and cities.

1879446335.name: Guide to Nobottle
1879446335.desc: Returns you and your Fellowship to Nobottle.\n\nThis skill is easily interrupted.

1879459391.name: Test Melee Common VPS
1879459391.desc: Does fixed common damage to test buffs and mitigations.

1879466431.name: Bastion of Light
1879466431.desc: Your connexion to the Light manifests beneath your feet; marking targets within the light making them susceptible to your debuffs.

1879484863.name: Guide to Bej Mâgha
1879484863.desc: Returns you and your Fellowship to the fishing village of Bej Mâgha.\n\nThis skill is easily interrupted.

1879485247.name: Steed of the Green Dragon Inn

1879486015.name: Friend of the Wilds (Lantern-guardian)
1879486015.desc: Summons a Bog-guardian companion.\n\nThe Bog-guardian excels at dealing damage from range.

1879490751.name: Cornered Vigour
1879490751.desc: Your companion is an accomplished hunter, and can push through pain. They will restore some Morale every time they are struck by an enemy.

1879508543.name: Armoured Scorpion
1879508543.desc: Summons a fearsome armoured scorpion to accompany you on your travels.

1879522367.name: Call to Greatness
1879522367.desc: You call out to your fellows, pushing yourself through pain to achieve impossible feats.

1879530559.name: Calf of High-land Pastures
1879530559.desc: Summons a high-land calf to wander the pastures with you.
